# Runtime dependencies for the pdvoice pipeline (pip / venv path — GPU box, no conda).
# torch + torchaudio are installed SEPARATELY from the CUDA index:
#   pip install torch torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
# then:  pip install -r env/requirements-gpu.txt  &&  pip install -e .

# --- core numerics / data ---
numpy<2.0
pandas
scipy
scikit-learn
pyyaml
joblib
tqdm

# --- audio I/O + DSP ---
librosa
soundfile
audioread

# --- classical voice features (jitter/shimmer/HNR/VOT) ---
praat-parselmouth

# --- voice activity detection ---
silero-vad

# --- SSL encoders ---
# Pin to 4.x: transformers 5.x refuses to load torch.load/.bin weights unless
# torch>=2.6 (CVE-2025-32434 guard), but the box is locked to torch 2.5.1+cu121
# (CUDA 12.2 driver can't run cu124 wheels) and all shortlisted encoders ship
# .bin only (no safetensors). 4.46.3 loads them fine.
transformers==4.46.3

# --- re-implementation of Rahmatallah et al. 2025 (scripts/rahmatallah_cnn.py) ---
# Keras 3 on the torch backend gives their InceptionV3 + ImageNet weights without
# TensorFlow. ml-dtypes must stay <0.5 or pip pulls numpy 2.x and breaks numpy<2.0.
keras>=3.6
ml-dtypes<0.5

# --- calibration / stats / plots ---
statsmodels
matplotlib

# --- notebooks + tests ---
ipykernel
jupyter
pytest

# --- Bridge2AI-Voice download (scripts/download_bridge2ai.py) ---
# token goes in ~/.synapseConfig, never in the repo
synapseclient
